request.description: Manual entry by ops or a telecaller (source `manual` unless `source` names another lead source). `consent` records what the person agreed to with `basis` and `evidence`; with contact and partner-sharing consent the lead is `consentStatus: ok`, otherwise it waits in the consent queue. `flags` may mark `test` or `spam`. At least one valid mobile, landline or email is required; an invalid extra number is kept as the `invalid_number` flag. The person is matched by contact (same contact and a compatible name links to the same person; a different name on the same contact opens a review). `category` may be a key or an alias, and `city` free text is resolved through aliases; anything unrecognised is kept and flagged (`unmapped_category`, `unmapped_location`). `amountText` such as "20-25 lakh" or "upto 1 cr" is parsed into paise. A repeat open enquiry for the same person and category within 30 days is flagged `duplicate`. `answers` go through the lead-capture questionnaire for the source and become declared facts. The original payload is stored encrypted. Staff only. Reading needs lead read access (ops lead, ops reviewer, compliance, support); changes need lead update access (ops lead, ops reviewer).
